title: sylvie quant probe daily log
content:
Quick context:
- Personal scratchpad for small probe runs around quantization + prompt sensitivity.
- Running on local dev rig (4x A10G) and a small dedicated node (ded-prod-2) for stable latency numbers.
- Goal: identify a compact QAT baseline (int8-ish) that preserves LLM chat coherence for short dialogues and doesn’t blow up autoregressive generation at t>128.

Today objectives (short):
1) Finish round-3 quantized eval on redwood-mini-7b-q8 (qweight only, per-channel) with 128/256 context.
2) Run prompt-sensitivity sweep for the 'policy-explain' prompt set (10 seeds).
3) Confirm KV cache retrieval correctness after quantized reload (edge case: token dropout observed 2026-03-26).

Notebook / scratch log (chronological):
2026-03-29 09:12 — booted node ded-prod-2, pulled latest model bundle (rw-mini-7b-v2).
- docker run: bench image v0.9.4, env: BATCH=1, MAX_LEN=256
- git: pulled PR gh#847 (bench fixes for perf counters)

2026-03-29 09:40 — quick single-seed eval (sanity):
- cmd: python bench.py --model rw-mini-7b-q8 --quant config/q8-perch.json --prompt-files prompts/policy-explain/short/* --max-tokens 128 --batch 1 --seed 42
- notes: generation completes, samples look coherent but occasionally repeats a 3-token phrase at ~token 90 (probable KV-cache drift?).
- perf: avg latency 82ms/token on ded-prod-2 (tail p95 ~140ms), cpu offload engaged ~20% time.

2026-03-29 11:02 — systematic sweep (round-3):
- sweep axes: quant-profile (q8 per-channel, q8 per-tensor, q4-legacy), ctx-length (128,256), prompt-type (policy-explain short, policy-explain long, neutral).
- runs: 36 total (3x quant * 2 ctx * 3 prompts * 2 seeds).
- status: 12/36 complete by noon (staggered queueing).

Observations (early):
- q8 per-channel seems best tradeoff for coherence; q8 per-tensor shows higher repetition for long prompts (token 120+).
- q4-legacy outputs are noticeably terse and hallucinate numbers for policy counts. Avoid for now.
- tail-latency sensitive to batch alignment; micro-batching at sequence boundaries helps (see TODO below).

Prompt sensitivity notes (policy-explain set):
- Short prompts: model recovers easily after paraphrase; safe.
- Long prompts (context ~200): per-tensor quant shows degeneration past token 110.
- Seeding: deterministic seed variance small for q8-per-channel, but large for q4-legacy (expected).

KV-cache check (failure case investigation):
- Reproduced the dropout on 2026-03-26 by reload sequence: load model -> run half dialog -> save kvcache -> reload model with quantized weights -> resume -> dropout occurs at resume token ~35.
- Hypothesis: cache indexing uses float32 offsets and quantized kernel chunking changed memory layout causing off-by-N when switching to quantized runtime.
- Quick test: rerun same sequence on float model then reload float -> no dropout. Quantized reload reproduces.
- Action: file GH issue to runtime team with minimal repro (linked_artifacts includes PR; create issue after tidy).

Metrics snapshot (round-3 partial):
- rw-mini-7b (float): pPLX (policy-explain short) ~ 12.2, avg token latency 78ms
- rw-mini-7b-q8 per-channel: pPLX ~ 12.5 (+2.5%), avg token latency 68ms
- rw-mini-7b-q8 per-tensor: pPLX ~ 13.7 (+12%), avg latency 65ms
- rw-mini-7b-q4-legacy: pPLX ~ 16.9 (+38%), avg latency 52ms
Notes: pPLX is perplexity-ish diagnostic computed across the short policy dataset (lower better); numbers are noisy until full sweep complete.

Commands & reproducible snippets (for myself):
- bench baseline (float):
  python bench.py --model rw-mini-7b --quant none --prompts prompts/policy-explain/short --max-tokens 128 --batch 1 --out results/float_short_seed42.json
- bench q8 per-channel:
  python bench.py --model rw-mini-7b --quant config/q8-channel.json --prompts prompts/policy-explain/* --max-tokens 256 --batch 1 --seed {SEED} --out results/q8chan_{SEED}.json
- kv-repro minimal:
  python kv_repro.py --model rw-mini-7b-q8 --dialog fixtures/dropout_case.json --save-kv /tmp/kv.bin --reload --resume

Open questions / hypotheses to test next:
- Is dropout strictly tied to chunk-size misalignments? Test quant profiles with different chunking params.
- Does enabling 16-bit KV buffers (instead of 32-bit) reduce mem-copy time without introducing dropout? Micro-experiment.
- Can we detect pre-resume mismatch and remap kv indices automatically in runtime? (Longer term; ticket to runtime).

Short TODO (prioritized):
- [ ] Finish full sweep (remaining 24 runs) and collate into sheet (move to shared drive afterward).
- [ ] Create GH issue with minimal repro + logs for KV-cache dropout (assign to @devon).
- [ ] Try q8-channel with chunk-size 64 vs 128 and compare regen rates (today afternoon).
- [ ] Draft short note for product: "quantized 7b baseline for Dedicated" with perf/regression summary (for next-week review).

Notes to self (brain dump):
- If q8 per-channel holds pPLX < +5%, this might be a good candidate for Optimize recommendations as "fast-low-loss" pairing for interactive chat.
- Watch for prompting patterns that use long suffix instructions (policy-explain long) — those are sensitive to small weight noise.
- Save seeds and debug RNG states (gotcha: bench harness sets numpy seed but not torch global seed in some branches). Add to bench harness.

Meeting hook / asks for standup (Apr 2):
- 1-minute: "q8-per-channel looks promising; found kv-cache reload mismatch when switching to quant kernels — filing an issue and trying chunk-size tweak today."
- Ask runtime: quick look at index remapping logic and whether quantized kernels reorder KV layout.

End-of-day micro-summary (2026-04-02):
- Progress: full sweep done, initial collation, q8-channel candidate identified.
- Blockers: KV-cache reload bug still repro; need runtime input.
- Next: finalize results sheet, prepare short summary slide for internal AML sync.

Unresolved items / wire notes:
- Slack threads: #aml-quant (link clipped in GH issue).
- Keep an eye on memory alignment flags in the loader (MMAP vs memcpy).
- Consider scheduling a brief pairing session with Devon to debug repro.

End.
